title: French Language Services Advisory Committee - November 13, 2025

agenda_items.title: Notices and meeting information for meeting participants and the public
agenda_items.description:
Members of Committee and Council, City staff, media and the general public may join the meeting with this link:
Zoom Webinar ID: 890 7796 9228
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and remote participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
The deadline to register to speak by phone or email, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on the day of the meeting.

agenda_items.title: Declarations of Interest
agenda_items.minutes: No Declarations of Interest were filed.

sub_agendas_items.title: 2026 Draft Operating and Capital Budget – French Language Services Advisory Committee
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Svetlana Valkova, Deputy Chief Finance Officer, Finance Services, provided a presentation on the 2026 draft operating and capital budget. Nathalie Lemire, Program Manager, French Language Services, provided an overview of the French Language Services (FLS) portion of the budget.
The Advisory Committee discussed and asked questions regarding the following topics:
The Advisory Committee received the presentation for information and carried Motion No. FLSAC 2025-09-01.
ACTION:

motions.motion_text:
Recommendation
That the French Language Services Advisory Committee receive the presentation for information.

BE IT RESOLVED that the French Language Services Advisory Committee (FLSAC) authorize the FLSAC Chair and Vice Chair to submit the Committee's consolidated comments on the 2026 Draft Operating and Capital Budget to the Committee Coordinator in advance of November 28 for circulation to Members of the Finance and Corporate Services Committee and Council.

sub_agendas_items.title: Presentation - Strategic Initiatives Department on strategies to support economic growth and resiliency
sub_agendas_items.description:
Emmanuel Rey, Officer, Economic Development Services, Strategic Initiatives Department, and Mathieu Grondin, Nightlife Commissioner, provided a presentation on supporting economic growth in a bilingual City.
The Advisory Committee discussed and asked questions regarding the following topics:
ACTION:
The Advisory Committee received the presentation for information.

motions.motion_text:
Recommendation
That the French Language Services Advisory Committee receive the presentation for information and provide feedback as appropriate.

agenda_items.minutes: There were no in camera items.

agenda_items.minutes: There were no Notices of Motion.

sub_agendas_items.title: Good Franco News
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Member Pierre-Jerome announced the success of the recent event Kaléidoscope 7ième édition hosted by Salon du livre afro-canadien. He also announced a book fair taking place at the École secondaire catholique Béatrice-Desloges. He committed to sharing more information by email after the meeting.
Nathalie Lemire, Program Manager (FLS), announced an upcoming event (Déjeuner des Flocons de neige) taking place at the Pauline Charron Centre in Vanier. She also highlighted the recent passing of Bernard Grandmaître. She committed to sharing more information by email after the meeting.
